summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CLOSR P0/P1/P2 features: Theme toggle, Supercharg'd mode, translation API, and template downloads. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0/P1/P2 features verified working: 1) Theme toggle (dark/light) with chrome button and localStorage persistence as 'closr_theme', 2) Supercharg'd mode toggle with animated flames, ES/EN label, orange glow effect, and localStorage persistence as 'closr_supercharged', 3) Tower Talk modal shows ES/EN badge when Supercharg'd active and generates bilingual responses with language toggle, 4) /api/translate endpoint works for EN→ES, ES→EN, and auto-detect, 5) Template downloads accessible at /templates/customers_template.csv and /templates/vehicles_template.csv, 6) Settings modal (SetupModal) loads and saves preferences to localStorage

theme_toggle.details: Chrome-style button with sun/moon icon, switches between dark/light mode, persists to localStorage as 'closr_theme'

supercharged_mode.details: Animated flames button, shows EN/ES label, orange glow when active, persists to localStorage as 'closr_supercharged'

tower_talk_translation.details: Shows ES/EN badge when Supercharg'd active, generates response and translates to Spanish, language toggle button works

translate_api.details: /api/translate endpoint works for EN→ES, ES→EN, and auto-detect source language

template_downloads.details: customers_template.csv and vehicles_template.csv accessible at /templates/ with proper CSV headers and sample data

settings_persistence.details: SetupModal loads preferences from localStorage, theme and supercharged preferences persist across page reloads
